offered_action_specs.name: rollback_deploy
offered_action_specs.description: Roll one service back to the settings it ran before its latest deploy, as the deploy log records them. Code plans it from that log, not from your tools' results, so you can name it even when they cannot see deploys: if the log holds no deploy of that service to undo, or the service changed since, code refuses it. Its container is recreated, so the service pauses while it restarts. Money already booked wrong stays wrong: a rollback stops new damage, and repairs nothing.

diagnosis.hypothesis: ledger-consumer was recreated at 18:39:02 with BAD_EVENTS=retry. proposed_fix.summary: Roll ledger-consumer back to the settings it ran before the 18:39:02 deploy, expected to be BAD_EVENTS=dead_letter. The stuck message 2@86 should then be dead-lettered and the backlog drained. Afterwards: inspect evt_000270 in the dead-letter store, compare it with the provider's record of pay_000248, and book or correct it by hand. Then run the money check.

If the earlier settings were also BAD_EVENTS=retry, the rollback will not unblock anything. Other malformed events further back would be dead-lettered too.
